Rules.InvariantScript:
With(
    { q: Lower(Trim(txtSetupSearch.Text)) },
    FirstN(
        Sort(
            Filter(
                Equipment_Setups,
                !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(Titel, ""))))
                    || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(SetupName, ""))))
            ),
            Titel
        ),
        25
    )
)
If(Parent.Width < 600, "Search a setup", "Type to search a setup by ID or name")

If(
    IsBlank(varEdLast),
    "Not set - tap to choose",
    Text(varEdLast, DateTimeFormat.LongDate)
)

If(
    IsBlank(varEdNext),
    "Not set - tap to choose",
    Text(varEdNext, DateTimeFormat.LongDate)
)

If(
    ThisItem.Value in colCommDone.Value,
    RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1),
    RGBA(0, 120, 212, 1)
)

If(
    ThisItem.Value in colCommDone.Value,
    RGBA(0, 120, 212, 1),
    RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1)
)

If(
    ThisItem.Value in colCommDone.Value,
    RGBA(16, 110, 190, 1),
    RGBA(235, 243, 252, 1)
)

If(
    ThisItem.Value in colCommDone.Value,
    Remove(
        colCommDone,
        LookUp(colCommDone, Value = ThisItem.Value)
    ),
    Collect(colCommDone, { Value: ThisItem.Value })
)

If(
    IsBlank(Trim(txtAssetID.Text)), "Asset ID is required.",
    IsBlank(Trim(txtDeviceName.Text)), "Device name is required.",
    varIsNewAsset && !IsBlank(LookUp(Equipment_Assets, Titel = Trim(txtAssetID.Text)).'Id (ID)'),
        "Asset ID " & Trim(txtAssetID.Text) & " already exists.",
    ""
)

If(
    ThisItem.CellDate = If(varEdPick = "last", varEdLast, varEdNext),
        RGBA(0, 120, 212, 1),
    ThisItem.CellDate = Today(), RGBA(222, 236, 249, 1),
    RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1)
)

If(
    ThisItem.CellDate = If(varEdPick = "last", varEdLast, varEdNext),
        RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1),
    Not(ThisItem.InMonth), RGBA(200, 198, 196, 1),
    RGBA(50, 49, 48, 1)
)
